result.summary: The page is largely well-formed, but there is one clear visual defect: the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card in the 'Popular right now' section is missing its hero image and displays a broken-image placeholder icon instead.

issues.description: The 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card in the 'Popular right now' section shows a gray broken-image placeholder instead of the restaurant photo, making the card look unfinished and inconsistent with other cards.
issues.suggestion: Fix the image URL or asset loading for this restaurant, and provide a branded fallback image (e.g., cuisine illustration or logo) when the photo fails to load instead of the generic broken-image icon.

issues.description: The 'Green Bowl Poké' card image appears mostly as a plain light-gray background with a small dish graphic, looking washed out compared to the richer, full-bleed photos on the neighboring 'Smash Bros Burgers' and 'Trattoria' cards.
issues.suggestion: Use a full-bleed, properly cropped photo for this restaurant so the card visual density matches the other cards in the carousel.
